phase-plan.purpose: Implement the loot/search economy pillar from the gameplay design by moving dungeon discovery into engine state, making search resolve real room rewards, granting mana-crystal combat rewards, turning floor completion into survey-map vs dark-map inventory outcomes, and wiring authored merchant buy/sell/buyback behavior into the current room loop.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: engine-owned discovered-room state, documented floor-map state, treasure-room crystal rewards, combat crystal rewards, full-room search resolution, merchant trade actions, sell/buyback behavior, KAPLAY consumption of engine discovery/trade state, and gameplay/docs/planning sync. Out of scope for this slice: the wider dungeon-pressure and authored interaction phases.

file.description: Add canonical runtime state for discovery and documented floors.
Own the reusable loot/discovery helpers so `game.ts` stays orchestration-first.
Search should resolve all present room loot and crystal rewards instead of taking only one item.
Fight/spell victory should grant mana-crystal rewards through the current action pipeline.
Player movement should mark discovery and document floors when the player climbs past them.
Gameplay tuning for treasure and combat crystal rewards plus dark-map penalty.
KAPLAY floor visibility should read engine-owned discovery state instead of browser-local storage.
Map overlay should surface documented floors and crystal counts from engine status.
Pressure helpers now support the economy loop with hostility decay and boss-spawn countdown state.
Inventory rows should expose sell actions from the runtime action graph.
Bag overlay should surface sell affordances while keeping trade in the live shell.
Document where discovery/loot/trade/pressure state now lives and what remains missing after this slice.

task.description: Move discovered-room tracking and documented-floor state into engine runtime state and use that for save/snapshot semantics.
Make search resolve the full authored room reward payload and grant treasure-room mana crystals through the inventory/search action path.
Grant mana-crystal combat rewards on player victories and surface the new runtime loot state in KAPLAY map/navigation consumers.
Finish the remaining authored economy surfaces: sell/buyback behavior, merchant-facing reward rules, and trade-specific UI/action flow.

decision.summary: Dungeon discovery is runtime state, not browser-local UI state.
decision.impact: KAPLAY now reflects engine snapshots directly, and save/restore can carry floor discovery and documented-map progress without a second client-only layer.

decision.summary: Leaving a floor upward documents that depth into either a survey map or a dark map based on discovery completeness.
decision.impact: Map items now participate in the inventory/loot loop immediately, and merchant trade can treat them as normal inventory-backed trade goods.

decision.summary: Merchant trade reuses the canonical inventory and mana-crystal economy instead of creating a second shop-only state model.
decision.impact: Buy, sell, and buyback now run through player and NPC inventory items, which keeps save/export/runtime behavior aligned with the existing content-pack system.
